scientific_overview.title: Common-reactant hydrated Tafel versus terrace hydride thermodynamics at -1.0 V RHE
scientific_overview.finding: At target mu -0.11930 Ha, the independently optimized hydrated on-top 2H state X90 is the common reference. Surface-bound terrace PbH2-like X21 is +0.305355 eV, terrace-displaced PbH2 X28 is +1.614976 eV, and molecular H2 X91 is -0.984956 eV relative to X90. The non-climbing Tafel path N19 has a sampled maximum +0.512562 eV relative to X90.
scientific_overview.limitations: These fixed-mu comparisons share nominal stoichiometry and hydration, but have different local water geometries and lack bulk-solution standard-state, thermal, and vibrational corrections. A terrace hydride-formation NEB connecting X90 to X21 remains missing in the hydrated model. Do not compare endpoint energies directly as rate constants.

scientific_overview.title: Low-coordinate Pb sites reduce local hydride detachment cost
scientific_overview.finding: For matched hydrated local processes at -1.0 V vs RHE, terrace PbH2 detachment costs +1.309621 eV, while detachment from an existing HCP Pb adatom costs +0.880822 eV. The local detachment energy reduction is 0.428799 eV.
scientific_overview.limitations: The comparison has different precursor morphology and Pb atom counts; it omits the energetic/kinetic cost of forming the adatom defect and cannot establish a net corrosion rate.

scientific_overview.title: Hydration avoids the tested dry Tafel proton-well catastrophe
scientific_overview.finding: The dry-model Tafel NEBs generated unphysical multi-eV stabilization of detached hydrogen. An explicit-water single-point at the problematic geometry X89 instead gave +2.566864 eV relative to the hydrated reactant. A subsequent hydrated NEB and endpoint-refined band sample a chemically plausible Tafel recombination sequence.
scientific_overview.limitations: Hydration is not a general proof of physical accuracy: other hydrated NEBs still exhibit proton-well problems, and electronic population/dielectric terms need inspection near bond formation.

scientific_overview.title: Potential-dependent continuum-only adsorption and detachment anomalies
scientific_overview.finding: Nominally comparable one-/two-H configurations differ by approximately 7.2-7.5 eV at selected potentials despite small ionic forces. Early continuum-only detachment pairs show differences of approximately 15.7-16.9 eV at several potentials. A partially lifted PbH2 trial X04 is about 16.18 eV below its source precursor.
scientific_overview.limitations: These discrepancies may reflect different physical/electronic basins or solvation-cavity artifacts. Treat them as diagnostics until geometries, charge, electronic branches, and water/solvent settings have been reconciled; they are not validated adsorption or extraction energies.

scientific_overview.title: Incomplete kinetic network
scientific_overview.finding: Earlier continuum-only NEBs screened separate-H to same-Pb rearrangement and initial PbH2 lifting. Hydrated detachment and on-top Tafel recombination have since been examined, but a hydrated X90-to-X21 surface hydride-formation path and proton-electron transfer HER elementary steps (Volmer/Heyrovsky) have not been demonstrated in this ledger.
scientific_overview.limitations: Do not infer selectivity or steady-state coverage from isolated pathway maxima. Missing molecular solution chemistry, pre-exponential factors, explicit proton donors, and electrochemical barriers must be considered in a consistent microkinetic framework.
